morning_hama.label: SOL 1m Morning HAMA — $1,000 target test
morning_hama.note: SOL 1m Morning HAMA test variant on SOL only, native 1m timeframe. The official engine has no take-profit (tp=False) and a -$100 per-trade dollar stop checked on the 1m bar's adverse extreme, after a $0.06 entry spread, on a $40,000 notional. This test applies a +$1,000 per-trade dollar take-profit the same way on the favorable extreme, filled at the exact price that makes that trade's P&L = $1,000. If the same 1m bar could hit both the -$100 stop and the +$1,000 target, the stop is filled first. Run and Start still use the official no-target engine. Notional, stop, $600 day bust, and the 08:00 Kyiv day filter are unchanged.
